takes.sourceDescription: football - throw, catch (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Mime Throwing and Receiving a Football, Participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts with hands gathered, turns and steps between repeated forward hand extensions and hands-up receiving poses, and ends facing sideways with knees bent and hands out.

takes.sourceDescription: football - throw, catch, jump around (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Mime a Football Exchange with Quick Steps, Participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A opens with both arms high, changes between quick steps and raised-hand reaches, then comes back toward an upright stance with hands in front. The CMU source identifies a football exchange.
